channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Farlands
item.description: Congratulations, you’ve bought your own planet! An agrarian rock at the edge of the galaxy that, for some reason, was practically being given away for free. So the time has come to leave your hectic, stressful life in an overcrowded metropolis for a more rural and rewarding life.

item.title: Farm Factory Simulator
item.description: Grow crops, automate production, and manage your own store. Turn fresh harvests into valuable products and create a wide range of goods. Optimize your workflow with efficient production chains and smart business decisions. Expand your facilities and build the fully automated farm-to-market business.

item.title: Happy's Humble Burger Cult
item.description: The original cooking horror returns in an unhinged co-op experience for 1-4 players. Grill burgers, serve customers, and hit your quota before the kitchen turns into a nightmare. When Asset Joy begins her hunt, try to escape alive and extract your hard-earned cash to survive another shift.

item.title: Ore Factory Squad ⛏️
item.description: Ore Factory Squad is a co-op mining and factory-building game with procedural mining and fun at its core! Play alone or with friends, buy properties, dig deep for valuable resources, complete contracts, upgrade and automate production lines and grow your factory from zero to industry!

item.title: Pathogenic
item.description: You are a disease. Infect the human body as a lone pathogen in this cellular roguelike shooter. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.

item.title: SAMURAI SHODOWN NEOGEO COLLECTION
item.description: The ULTIMATE collection is here! It all began in ’93, and now, the weapon-based fighting game series that swept the world is ready to be taken home in a new stellar collection! Six NEOGEO titles as well as one mysterious, unreleased game are featured!

item.title: SNK HEROINES Tag Team Frenzy
item.description: Take control of SNK’s most iconic female characters and battle it out in this crazy tag fighting game featuring a plethora of cute costumes and accessories! With one button special moves and a deep but simplified combo system this is a great game for fighting game fans and newcomers alike!

item.title: SNK VS. CAPCOM SVC CHAOS
item.description: SNK and CAPCOM legends clash in this star-studded crossover fighting game! The 2003 arcade hit SVC CHAOS is back and better than ever!

item.title: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV
item.description: SHATTER ALL EXPECTATIONS! Transcend beyond your limits with KOF XV!

item.title: Wabisabi SushiDerby
item.description: Adorable sushi race at full speed in a training × racing game! Become a sushi chef, craft unique toppings, and enter your trained sushi into races. Don't forget to cheer on your sushi during the race. Win the prestigious S1 Cup championship, and become a top-tier sushi chef!

item.title: Better Than Dead
item.description: A brutal bodycam revenge FPS set in Hong Kong. Slide into bullet time, fight up close, learn each environment's rhythm, and turn every run into a faster, bloodier revenge scene.

item.title: Easy Red 2: Ardennes 1940 & 1944
item.description: Command history in Easy Red 2: Ardennes 1940 & 1944! Blitz through the early chaos of WWII's Invasion of France, then brace for the brutal winter battles of the Ardennes campaign. Will you rewrite the pages of history?

item.title: Easy Red 2: Normandy
item.description: With Easy Red 2: Normandy you will experience the historic battles of the D-Day landings and beyond in immersive detail. Fight as Allied or Axis forces on faithfully recreated missions, using vehicles, and tactics to turn the tide of war.

item.title: Easy Red 2: Shanghai - Nanking
item.description: Explore detailed battles in the crucial 1937 conflict in China. New weapons, uniforms, vehicles, and missions await you with the new Shanghai-Nanking DLC.

item.title: Easy Red 2: Stalingrad
item.description: The Volga River is not lost yet! Come on comrades! With Easy Red 2: Stalingrad you will expand the front to the East for the first time, in the heart of the Soviet Union with new weapons, vehicles, uniforms and missions!

item.title: MEGATON MUSASHI W: WIRED
item.description: Launch a counteroffensive to take back the Earth from alien invaders in this mecha action RPG.

item.title: Nested Lands
item.description: Nested Lands is a ruthless medieval RPG game featuring in-depth village building, large-scale social management and combats. Gather survivors, build a settlement, craft, master your skills, survive, and endure alone or in online co-op.

item.title: Talisman: Digital Classic Edition
item.description: The complete 4th Edition experience of the classic fantasy adventure board game, Talisman. On your travels, you will need strength, courage and some good dice rolls to survive the dangers you face and beat your opponents to the centre of the board!

item.title: 70s-style Robot Anime Geppy-X
item.description: A fully remastered 70s-style super robot anime meets fast-paced arcade-style 2D side-scrolling shooter action. A Japanese cult classic finally available worldwide — now reborn in HD.

item.title: Catch Me!
item.description: Compete online against your friends and other players in this chaotic and fast paced 4-player game of tag! Race across different locations, jump through windows, electrocute the other players, or throw cats at them. (No cats were harmed in the production of this game.)

item.title: Cozy Grove
item.description: Welcome to Cozy Grove, a game about camping on a haunted, ever-changing island. As a Spirit Scout, you'll wander the island's forest each day, finding new hidden secrets and helping soothe the local ghosts. With a little time and a lot of crafting, you'll bring color and joy back to Cozy Grove!

item.title: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit
item.description: All those who are lost deserve kindness. Help cute, ghostly bears find peace in this relaxing sequel to the beloved life-sim game Cozy Grove, where kindness rules and new crafting, building, and camping island adventures await.

item.title: Denshattack!
item.description: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

item.title: Easy Red 2
item.description: Experience massive battles with infantry, tanks, artillery, and aircraft on large destructible open-world maps. Equip yourself, coordinate with your squad, and fight through World War II in singleplayer, co-op, or multiplayer!

item.title: Easy Red 2: Blood on the Danube
item.description: Fight through Hungary’s final WWII battles with dozens of new vehicles, weapons, missions, and new factions!

item.title: FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time
item.description: Step into this Slow-Life RPG where you can freely switch between 14 unique jobs, so called "Lives," and enjoy a carefree life in a fantasy world. Fish, cook, shape the island to your liking, or team up with friends to battle monsters across the vast world.

item.title: INAZUMA ELEVEN: Victory Road
item.description: The latest entry in the character collection and football simulation RPG series, "Inazuma Eleven!" With an original story featuring new main characters, over 5,400 players from across the series' history to collect and train, as well as exciting online tournaments, you can play the game your way!

item.title: Nevergrind
item.description: Embark on a legendary treasure-hunt in Vandamor! Master real-time combat and build lethal chain combos for epic rewards. Define your playstyle with a unique talent tree and discover powerful items! Experience a streamlined dungeon crawl focused on pure combat and treasure hunting!

item.title: Suzerain
item.description: Assume the role of President Anton Rayne and guide the nation of Sordland. Amidst brewing international conflicts, need for reform, deep-seated corruption, and economic recession, you must make the decisions in this political drama. How will you lead?

item.title: Teeto
item.description: Explore a world of mayhem and Michaels! Join Teeto the blob and Nory the bunny in this 3D adventure platformer to stop the shadow corruption from spreading. Absorb wild powers, help eccentric characters, and save the world - one Michael at a time!

item.title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu – Lost Explorers' Swords Pack
item.description: Enhance your armory with the Lost Explorers' Swords Pack and unlock two exclusive looks before heading out on expedition.
